sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.body: This standard establishes the governing requirements for Corporate Governance Framework within Ahmad A. Abed Holding Co. (AAA). It defines the mandatory controls, responsibilities and standards of practice required to ensure consistent, compliant and auditable execution across all in-scope entities.

sections.heading: 2. Scope
sections.body: Applies to all AAA entities, departments and personnel involved in Corporate Governance activities, including Head Office, subsidiaries, branches, showrooms and warehouses, unless a documented exception is approved through the governance change process.

sections.heading: 3. Definitions
sections.body: Key terms used in this document (Owner, Approver, Control, Record, Exception) carry the meanings defined in the AAA Governance Glossary (STD-GOV-014). Where a term is not defined, the plain business meaning applies.

sections.heading: 4. Policy Statements / Requirements
sections.body: AAA shall maintain documented, version-controlled procedures for Corporate Governance Framework. All activities must be performed by authorised personnel, evidenced by records, and reviewed against the KPIs defined in Section 7. Deviations require a logged exception and risk acceptance by the domain owner.

sections.heading: 5. Procedure
sections.body:
5.1 Initiate the Corporate Governance Framework request and validate inputs.
5.2 Perform the activity per the approved method and controls.
5.3 Capture records and required approvals per the Delegation of Authority.
5.4 Reconcile, review and escalate exceptions.
5.5 Archive records per the retention schedule.

sections.heading: 6. Roles & Responsibilities
sections.body: Responsibilities are governed by the RACI matrix for this process. The Domain Owner is Accountable; the Process Owner is Responsible; Risk & Compliance and Finance are Consulted where controls have financial or regulatory impact; affected teams are Informed.

sections.heading: 7. KPIs & Controls
sections.body: Cycle time, exception rate, on-time approval %, and audit findings are tracked monthly. Control effectiveness is assessed each review cycle and reported to the Governance Command Center.

sections.heading: 8. References
sections.body: AAA Delegation of Authority; relevant SFDA / SASO / ZATCA / MHRSD regulations as applicable; ISO 9001 / ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000 where the domain is certified.

sections.heading: 9. Revision History
sections.body: See Version Control. All changes are managed through Change Requests with documented approvals.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.body: This process establishes the governing requirements for Breakdown & Work Order Process within Ahmad A. Abed Holding Co. (AAA). sections.heading: 2. Scope

sections.heading: 3. Definitions
sections.body: Key terms used in this document (Owner, Approver, Control, Record, Exception) carry the meanings defined in the AAA Governance Glossary (STD-GOV-014). Where a term is not defined, the plain business meaning applies.

sections.heading: 4. Policy Statements / Requirements
sections.body: AAA shall maintain documented, version-controlled procedures for Breakdown & Work Order Process. All activities must be performed by authorised personnel, evidenced by records, and reviewed against the KPIs defined in Section 7. Deviations require a logged exception and risk acceptance by the domain owner.
